cloudRepresentation: Continuous domain-warped density with four merged scales, short feathered contours and sunward density relief. Derivatives apply only to the continuous field; no per-cell lobe, discontinuous coordinate derivative, repeating pod or raymarch remains.
scope: Only the owned sky shader and cloud frequency. Removes the visible cell seams and repeated ellipsoid clouds while keeping the blue palette, original night and fully overcast paths. Target-device profiling is still required before any performance claim.
